params.name: format
params.value: ($1), who needs the tutorial? Click on the players or select from the middle.

preset.text: Two teams: Sun and Moon, each split into two subteams (Sun #1/#2, Moon #1/#2). Each subteam gets a secret word and must come up with 3 one-word clues to help their counterpart subteam guess it.

Before your clues reach your counterpart, an opposing subteam swaps one of them for any other word. The doctored clues are what your counterpart sees — they have a fixed time to yell out guesses for your secret word.

Your first clue must start with a specific letter. You pick Easy, Medium, Hard, or Fiendish — if your counterpart guesses right, your team earns 1, 2, 3, or 4 points respectively. If they miss, the other team earns 1 point.
All 3 clues must be unique, must relate to the secret word's meaning, and cannot be too close to the secret word itself. After each round, the host can reset scores, keep scores, or end the game.

Players with YOUR border color are your "crew". You will all come up with clues together.

Players with the OTHER border color are your "counterparts". They will guess your secret word based on your clues.

preset.header: Are you ready to start the game?
preset.text: Once enough people have clicked Ready, the game will proceed!

preset.title: Pick one letter
preset.question: Choose the difficulty of your first clue's letter. A higher difficulty earns you more points if your counterparts guess your word!
